scope: Three standalone product card designs, not grid layouts. Same content and controls. No storefront code changes. Generated artwork and font rendering are approximations.

briefs.name: white-sleeve
briefs.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE standalone redesigned ecommerce PRODUCT CARD for Hey Kahani. The user is redesigning the card itself, NOT the arrangement of a grid. Show exactly ONE portrait card centered on white with narrow white margins, flat front view, crisp high-fidelity UI, approximately 900x1200px. Use the attached local Holi Koel artwork faithfully. Product remains a physical circular story disc with original Holi kite illustration, cream rim and realistic subtle shadow; do not replace the image or turn it into square cover art. Card's inventory is strictly: original artwork, exact title "Holi Kite Play", exact category badge "Kahani Original", a play triangle and "Preview" secondary action, and "Add to bag" primary action. These are the ONLY words/elements. No prices, hearts, ages, durations, ratings, ribbons, labels, brand logo, navigation, comparison title, option number, decorative doodles, arrows or extra features. Preserve all five elements. Text black #000000, primary button solid Gulab Red #D3000A white text, pill shape and subtle red shadow, Preview black text in frosted-light pill. Open Sans for interface and title, real realistic web typography. Warm Kesar Sand #FFF1D6 and white surfaces only, except red frame if requested. Card footprint same across variants: width roughly 360 CSS px and height roughly 520 CSS px. Comfortable 20px inset; artwork occupies top 65%, title beneath in 24px bold, category badge below in 15px, final shared bottom-aligned action row Preview at left and Add to bag at right. No large dead gap under artwork. Art/title/badge/actions must all be fully visible, unclipped and legible. Render only this one product card, no surrounding webpage. DESIGN A, WHITE SLEEVE: The card is a white rounded container with a very fine warm-neutral edge and barely perceptible shadow. The upper media region is a square pale Kesar Sand stage, flush with top and side edges of the card, rounded at upper corners only. The disc fills this square almost edge-to-edge with 16px breathing room. Lower information region white. Title and original category badge left aligned. Tightly grouped metadata. Bottom action row stays inside white footer. Restrained, precise catalogue card. Do not make whole card cream. The stage-to-white-footer transition is clear and flat, no gradient. Both pill buttons same height.
